summary.en: Action hierarchy, size, loading and duplicate submission
summary.zh-CN: 动作层级、尺寸、加载与重复提交

native.en: widgets.Button / widgets.button; the basic action contract can be mapped, and host events use widgets.Action.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Button / widgets.button；基础动作契约可对应，宿主事件使用 widgets.Action。

summary.en: Labels, help, errors and input recovery
summary.zh-CN: 标签、帮助、错误、只读与输入恢复

native.en: widgets.Editor / widgets.input / widgets.text_area; native IME, selection and clipboard are handled by the host.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Editor / widgets.input / widgets.text_area；原生 IME、选区与剪贴板由宿主处理。

summary.zh-CN: 状态文字、通知、等待与确认

native.en: Cross-host interaction principles; this library's browser dialog does not mean that native hosts already provide an API of the same name.
native.zh-CN: 跨宿主交互原则；此库的浏览器 dialog 不等于原生宿主已经提供同名 API。

summary.en: Opening, arrow keys, disabled entries and closing
summary.zh-CN: 展开、方向键、禁用项与退出

native.en: Native widgets.Menu and ui.MenuEntry both provide menu capabilities; hierarchy, shortcuts and the host menu bar need separate adaptation.
native.zh-CN: 原生 widgets.Menu 与 ui.MenuEntry 均有菜单能力；层级、快捷键和宿主菜单栏需要单独适配。

summary.en: Selection, arrow keys and linked panels
summary.zh-CN: 选中关系、方向键与关联面板

native.en: Where a native tab control exists, adapt it to the host focus model; this library only commits to this Web automatic-activation pattern.
native.zh-CN: 有原生页签控件时按宿主焦点模型适配；本库只承诺此 Web 自动激活模式。

summary.en: Sorting, pagination, empty results and action names
summary.zh-CN: 排序、分页、空结果和操作名称

native.en: widgets.Table supports native tables and sorting; pagination belongs to the application data model and is not claimed to be provided automatically by the host.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Table 支持原生表格与排序；分页属于应用数据模型，不声称由宿主自动提供。

summary.zh-CN: 展开层级、选中项目与可见项导航

native.en: Native Tree capabilities must be verified against the actual SDK interface; this Web tree uses the WAI-ARIA tree model.
native.zh-CN: 原生 Tree 能力需要对照实际 SDK 接口验证；此 Web 树使用 WAI-ARIA tree 模型。

summary.en: Constrained panel sizes and keyboard adjustment
summary.zh-CN: 受约束的面板尺寸与键盘调整

native.en: Native split layouts are adapted to host size constraints; Web pointer capture and the DOM separator must not be treated directly as a native implementation.
native.zh-CN: 原生分割布局按宿主尺寸约束适配；Web 指针捕获与 DOM separator 不能直接当作原生实现。

summary.en: 2D canvas primitives, series toggling, keyboard point inspection and chart types
summary.zh-CN: 2D 画布图元、序列显隐、键盘数据点检视与图表类型切换

native.en: draw.Frame / draw.Path / draw.Surface / widgets.Chart; native XDF1 frames and CTM/layer stacks are verified by the host.
native.zh-CN: draw.Frame / draw.Path / draw.Surface / widgets.Chart；原生 XDF1 帧记录与 CTM／图层栈由宿主校验执行。

summary.en: Immediate binary toggle switch with instant state readout and disabled preconditions
summary.zh-CN: 即时生效的二元开关控件，提供实时状态读数与禁用前提说明

native.en: widgets.Switch / widgets.switch_control and #ui/phone phone.toggle_switch; animated transitions honor reduced-motion settings.
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Switch / widgets.switch_control 与 #ui/phone 的 phone.toggle_switch；滑块过渡遵循系统减动效偏好。

summary.en: Mutually exclusive single-choice option rows with fieldset semantics and keyboard arrows
summary.zh-CN: 互斥单选列表行与分组语义，支持键盘方向键切换与选中高亮

native.en: widgets.Radio / widgets.RadioGroup and #ui/phone radio_row / check_row / segmented; host group semantics live in widgets/phone modules.
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Radio / widgets.RadioGroup 与 #ui/phone 的 radio_row / check_row / segmented；原生焦点切换由控件运行时承担。

summary.en: Bounded continuous or stepped numeric adjustment with thumb target and tabular readout
summary.zh-CN: 有界连续或步进数值调节器，配触控尺寸滑块与等宽实时读数

native.en: widgets.Slider / widgets.RangeSlider and #ui/phone phone.slider; thumb geometry follows phone_slider_thumb.
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Slider / widgets.RangeSlider 与 #ui/phone 的 phone.slider；移动端滑块尺寸对齐 phone_slider_thumb。

summary.en: Determinate progress bar with semantic phases and reduced-motion spinner fallback
summary.zh-CN: 确定任务进度条与多语义状态阶段，支持忙碌指示与减动效静态回退

native.en: widgets.Progress / widgets.ProgressBar and #ui/phone phone.progress_bar; track height aligns with phone_progress_height.
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Progress / widgets.ProgressBar 与 #ui/phone 的 phone.progress_bar；移动端轨道高度对齐 phone_progress_height。

summary.en: Semantic inline pills, 99+ counters and labeled unread status dots
summary.zh-CN: 语义状态胶囊、99+ 计数角标与带无障碍说明的未读状态点

native.en: widgets.Badge / badge_attachment (status, count, dot) and #ui/phone phone.badge; count badge uses brand + on_brand.
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Badge / badge_attachment（状态、计数、圆点）与 #ui/phone 的 phone.badge；计数底色取自 brand / on_brand。

summary.en: Blocking confirmation overlay with focus containment, Escape dismissal and focus restore
summary.zh-CN: 带遮罩的阻断式确认弹窗，锁定内部焦点并在退出时恢复原焦点

native.en: widgets.Modal / modal_dialog with xuui_tokens.overlay(dark) and #ui/phone confirm_dialog (phone_dialog_radius).
native.zh-CN: 对应 widgets.Modal / modal_dialog（使用 xuui_tokens.overlay(dark)）与 #ui/phone 的 confirm_dialog（phone_dialog_radius）。

title.zh-CN: Phone 外壳与移动端控件

summary.en: Adaptive bottom bar vs rail, safe areas, pushed routes, bottom sheet, confirm dialog and mobile form/list primitives
summary.zh-CN: 自适应底栏与导航轨、安全区避让、路由栈、底部抽屉、确认弹窗及全套移动端表单与列表原语

native.en: #ui/phone adaptive shell, route stack, bottom sheet, confirm_dialog, toggle_switch, progress_bar, badge, slider, radio/check rows, divider, empty_state and xuui_tokens mobile metrics; device safe areas, IME insets and fling physics require host validation.
native.zh-CN: #ui/phone 自适应外壳、路由栈、底部抽屉、confirm_dialog、toggle_switch、progress_bar、badge、slider、单选/多选行、divider、empty_state 与 xuui_tokens 移动度量；真机安全区、软键盘与滚动物理须在宿主侧验证。

summary.en: Formatted text, toolbar, inline runs, blocks and assistive tech
summary.zh-CN: 格式化文本、工具栏、行内片段、块级段落与辅助技术

native.en: widgets.RichEditor / widgets.rich_editor; native IME proxy and DirectWrite / CoreText multi-run text layouts with platform UIA / NSAccessibility text pattern bridging.
native.zh-CN: widgets.RichEditor / widgets.rich_editor；原生 IME 代理与 DirectWrite / CoreText 多运行片段文本排版，并桥接平台 UIA / NSAccessibility 文本模式接口。

summary.en: Dockable panels, drag drop zones, tab reordering and keyboard moves
summary.zh-CN: 可停靠面板、拖拽放置区、标签重排与键盘移动替代

native.en: widgets.Workspace / widgets.SplitView; native multi-canvas host docking, OLE / Cocoa drag-and-drop protocol bridging with platform drop targets.
native.zh-CN: widgets.Workspace / widgets.SplitView；原生多画布宿主停靠容器，桥接 Win32 OLE / macOS Cocoa 系统级拖放协议与目标注册。
